name: Timelogbook
author: Smart Terminal
summary: Your Timelogbook v4 tasks beside your terminals, and Timelogbook's MCP tools in every Claude session — through one API key.
description: Timelogbook v4 serves an MCP server for each app of the suite — My work, Tasks, Projects, CRM and the rest — and an API key you make in Timelogbook (Profile → API keys) decides which of them you reach and whether it may write. Paste the key and your Timelogbook address once: the app asks every server what the key reaches and shows it. My tasks lists what is overdue, due today, upcoming, undated or done, searchable, and Ask Claude opens a session that has already been handed the task as Timelogbook describes it. Tools lets you run any tool the key reaches and read the answer as a tree. Switch on Claude access and every Claude session in this app gets a timelogbook MCP server with those same tools, running as you. The key is kept by the app, encrypted by your system's keychain; this panel never holds it, it is never written into a session's config, and any tool Timelogbook does not mark as read-only is shown to you in a dialog before it runs — whoever asked.
